summary_under_15_lines: Verdict A: PASS for the requested narrow claim: neutral shape-only trace supports one later native diagnostic; this is NOT a product pass and D244 remains open.
The existing single CDP Escape keyDown/keyUp, focus precondition, wait predicate, and visible/open-dialog acceptance checks are unchanged from HEAD.

Verdict B: PASS with a material observation limit: listeners do not mutate events, alter focus, invoke/wrap handlers, or call product callbacks; cleanup removes listeners and disconnects the observer.

The exact serialized probe expression is exercised in Happy DOM; tests cover target/focus divergence, propagation boundaries, transitions/removal, caps/cleanup, tooltip/prop presence, and JSON sanitizer forwarding.
Failure receipts attach the trace from the last observed close state and place it in values_close_diagnostic; the sanitizer test serializes a trace produced by the exact probe expression.
Privacy: only fixed shape vocabulary, event booleans/numbers, boundary names, and bounded arrays are retained; no text, HTML, URL, IDs, classes, values, or auth data are read into records.
Limit: no native rerun was performed, so observer timing effects remain unmeasured; the MutationObserver watches document-wide child-list churn, though retained output is capped.

verdict_a.claim: A neutral truthful trace supports one later native diagnostic; it does not establish that Values Escape works.
evidence: HEAD diff confirms the prior one native Escape delivery remains one keyDown plus keyUp; no extra native key was added.
Pre-Escape focus checks and close predicate (zero open-state and visible dialogs plus trusted key delivery) are unchanged.

The trace can distinguish target/path outside while focus remains inside; missing event boundaries; close/reopen/removal; tooltip count; and forwarded handler-prop presence, with stated interpretation limits.

The success receipt includes escape_boundary_trace. On the failure route, the last observed close state is attached to the timeout error, safeValuesCloseDiagnostic forwards it, and the main catch assigns that diagnostic into the report.
Observer test builds a trace by executing the exact serialized expression, passes it through the real sanitizer, and JSON serializes the resulting receipt.
open: No native run was performed by this verifier; Values Escape remains a native product defect under the prior trusted failure.
The trace does not prove React handler entry or callback/state-setter execution. dialogReactKeyDownPropPresent relies on a private React DOM prop naming convention and is explicitly presence-only.
Listeners added after existing listeners may miss a boundary if stopImmediatePropagation is used; absent boundaries localize an interval, not a precise listener.
MutationObserver captures callback-time DOM state and may miss batched state changes with no DOM mutation; it observes the original dialog only.

quality: No product source or event behavior is modified. Observer only reads DOM/event state, installs passive-by-behavior listeners (no preventDefault/stopPropagation calls), and observes mutations.
stop is idempotent, drains pending records, disconnects the observer, and removes listeners; driver retains its existing finally cleanup.
Records and transition arrays are capped at 32 with explicit dropped counters; composed paths are capped at 16 fixed-vocabulary shapes with explicit truncation flag.
The two new observer tests cover real observer logic in synthetic DOM; existing synthetic driver tests stub the observer dependency, clearly documented in the harness.
verdict_b.privacy: PASS: the observer never stores event text, element text/HTML, URL, IDs, class names, attribute values beyond a boolean old data-state, or auth material. Unknown tags collapse to 'other'.
verdict_b.forcing_guard_review: The focused tests fail when expected boundary sequences or transitions are absent, and exercise the serialization path. Builder-reported scratch mutation results were not independently rerun in this verifier; no product test is claimed by these unit tests.
verdict_b.limitation: The MutationObserver subscribes to document-wide childList changes and loops over each delivered mutation to detect original-dialog removal/reinsertion. Output storage is bounded, but callback work is not strictly bounded by the record cap; native timing perturbation remains unmeasured.
